paragraphs.en: Iris woke to the sound of a falling counterweight. She was no longer in her editing office but inside the royal theater of her favorite unfinished novel. People called her Lady Liora, the cruel supervisor destined to be executed after a dancer died on coronation night. A young engineer named Nilo was examining a suspended lamp when she saw the red thread tied around its release rope. She remembered that thread from a drawing in the book. Instead of ordering the rehearsal to continue, she shouted for the stage to be cleared and reached the emergency brake herself. A clerk tried to abbreviate the damaged rope’s label before Liora stopped him. The emergency brake became the anchor of the crew’s temporary safety plan. The same inspection rules were applicable to royal and ordinary performances alike. Jun carried the signed log to the independent archive across the square.
paragraphs.zh: 伊芮絲在配重墜落聲中醒來。她已不在自己的編輯辦公室，而是在最喜歡的未完小說裡，那座王家劇院。人們稱她為莉奧拉女士——注定在加冕之夜舞者死亡後遭處死的冷酷監督。年輕工程師尼洛正在檢查懸掛的燈具，她看見釋放繩索上綁著一條紅線。她記得書中插圖畫過那條線。她沒有命令排練繼續，而是高聲要求舞台清空，親自伸手拉下緊急煞車。 一名書記想縮寫受損繩索的標籤，莉奧拉制止了他。 緊急煞車成了工班臨時安全計畫的支點。 同一套檢查規則對王室和一般演出都適用。 阿筠把簽署紀錄送到廣場另一端的獨立檔案庫。

paragraphs.en: Jun brought the dancers into the costume room and shut the door against the noise of the brake. Evi held her notebook against her bosom while describing where she had stood. A bra lay outside the trunk where it belonged; Jun recorded the disturbed costume before putting anything back. A messenger offered a bribe if she would leave the trunk out of her report. She asked him to repeat the offer with Evi listening. He would not. While the cooks began to broil vegetables for the waiting crew, Jun wrote his exact first words beneath the rehearsal time.
paragraphs.zh: 阿筠帶舞者進戲服室，關門隔開煞車聲。艾薇把筆記本抱在胸前，描述當時站的位置。一件胸罩掉在應屬的箱子外，阿筠先記下戲服被翻動的情況，沒有收回去。信差提出賄賂，要她別把箱子寫進報告。她請他當著艾薇再說一遍，他不肯。廚師開始為等待工班炙烤蔬菜時，阿筠在排練時間下面記下他首次提出的原話。

paragraphs.en: The lamp stopped a handspan above the floor. Dancer Evi, only twenty-two, stared at the empty spot where she should have been standing. The royal patron, Corvin, demanded to know why the celebrated finale had been interrupted. Liora could not tell him she had read a future that might never happen. She showed him the cut fibers on the release rope, asked the crew to photograph their positions, and sealed the brake handle against further use. She also asked Jun, the costume master, to take the performers to a room away from the machinery. Nilo demanded a comparative test with a second undamaged release rope. Liora blinked one aching eyelid while checking the brake diagram again. Their time was finite, but rushing would turn a repair into another hazard. Only transparent records would let the theater flourish after the festival.
paragraphs.zh: 吊燈停在距離地面不到一掌的高度。二十二歲的舞者艾薇凝視本來應該站立的位置。王室贊助人科爾文質問她，為何打斷備受矚目的終幕。莉奧拉不能告訴他，自己讀過一段也許根本不會發生的未來。她指給他看釋放繩索上的割痕，請工班拍下各自位置，並封住煞車把手，禁止再啟動。她又請戲服主管阿筠把表演者帶往遠離機械的房間。 尼洛要求拿另一條完好的釋放繩索進行比較測試。 莉奧拉重新核對煞車圖時，眨了眨痠痛的眼皮。 他們的時間有限，但倉促修理只會製造新的危險。 只有透明紀錄，劇院才能在節慶後持續蓬勃發展。

paragraphs.en: An injured rigger waited by the side door, shifting his weight to ease his limp. A hired gangster outside the dressing room had frightened two apprentices away from him. Liora asked a steward to keep the passage clear, then invited the rigger to narrate what he had seen without the apprentices listening first. He pointed out the junction where two overhead lines crossed. Nilo marked it on the plan and asked which line had moved when the brake caught. The rigger could identify the movement, but not a person at the release. Liora left that part of his statement blank.
paragraphs.zh: 受傷的吊掛工站在側門，換腳承重減輕跛行不適。更衣室外一名受雇黑幫分子嚇跑了原本陪他的兩名學徒。莉奧拉請管事維持通道暢通，再請吊掛工先自行敘述，不讓學徒先聽。他指出兩條高空線路的交會接點。尼洛在圖面標記，詢問煞車扣住時哪條線移動。他能辨認動作，卻無法指出釋放處站著誰。莉奧拉把證詞那部分留白。

paragraphs.en: By evening the palace announced that Liora had endangered the ceremony through needless alarm. It was the first public sentence in the novel that she had managed to change, and it came with a cost. Nilo admitted that Liora herself had approved the old safety plan months earlier. She did not deny it or blame a subordinate; she signed an order suspending the device and requested an independent inspection. If she intended to protect the people inside this story, she would first have to make herself answerable to them. An orderly placed barriers around the unused staircase until repairs finished. The theater’s ticket teller confirmed that no audience had entered yet. The crew compared old paint with virgin timber that had never been installed. A judge issued a narrow warrant for the sealed maintenance locker.
paragraphs.zh: 到了傍晚，王宮發布公告，稱莉奧拉以無端恐慌危及典禮。這是她在小說裡成功改變的第一句公開敘述，卻也付出代價。尼洛指出，數月前批准舊安全計畫的人正是莉奧拉本人。她沒有否認，也沒有把責任推給下屬；她簽令停用裝置，並要求獨立檢查。如果她想保護這個故事裡的人，就得先讓他們有權追究她的責任。 一名勤務員在維修結束前封鎖閒置樓梯。 劇院售票員確認當時尚無觀眾進場。 工班把舊油漆與從未安裝的全新木材比較。 法官核發範圍有限的搜索令，以檢查封存的維修置物櫃。

questions.question: Why does Liora stop the rehearsal?
options: She sees damage on a release rope.
She wants to close the theater forever.
questions.explanation: 她發現釋放繩索受損，立即停止排練以防墜落事故。

questions.question: How does Liora respond to her earlier approval?
options: She accepts responsibility and seeks inspection.
She accuses the apprentice without evidence.
questions.explanation: 她承認曾批准計畫，簽令停用並要求獨立檢查。

paragraphs.en: The inspection began above the auditorium, where two narrow catwalks crossed beneath the roof. Nilo showed Liora a pulley that had been polished on one side and roughly filed on the other. A single photograph could not reveal when the damage occurred. She appointed Jun and a visiting carpenter as independent observers. The carpenter had traveled from the mountain provinces to build the festival scenery. He knew the materials, but he refused to make an accusation before the bolts had been counted. Liora found his restraint more useful than Corvin’s confident speeches. An aboriginal woodcarver explained why his community seasoned timber for years. The mountain workshops abound with skilled craftspeople, not cheap substitutes. The two catwalk marks did not align with the official building plan. At that altitude, even a small wind changed how suspended fabric moved.
paragraphs.zh: 檢查從觀眾席上方開始，兩條狹窄的工作走道在屋頂下交叉。尼洛讓莉奧拉看一個滑輪，一側磨得發亮，另一側卻有粗糙的銼痕。單憑一張照片無法判定損傷發生的時間。她指派阿筠與來自外地的木匠擔任獨立見證。木匠從山區省分前來搭建節慶布景，熟悉材料，卻拒絕在螺栓清點前指控任何人。莉奧拉覺得，這份克制遠比科爾文充滿自信的演說有用。 一名原住民族木雕師解釋族人為何要多年陰乾木材。 山區工坊有許多熟練工匠，不是廉價替代品。 兩條走道標記與官方建築圖並未對齊。 在那個高度，即使微風也會改變懸掛布料的動向。

paragraphs.en: Jun held the carpenter's lamp as he approached the narrow crossing. The superintendent laughed at the delay, and she turned away to hide her annoyance. Evi answered him with a blunt refusal to rehearse below them. Nilo asked for a second guardrail before anyone leaned farther over the gap. A worker offered to discard the cracked pulley to make room for the replacement. Nilo stopped his hand and laid a numbered cloth beneath the part instead. The carpenter could now count the bolts without losing fragments through the open floor. Jun wrote the part number beside the suspended rehearsal notice.
paragraphs.zh: 阿筠提著木匠的燈，陪他靠近狹窄交會通道。總監嘲笑拖延，她轉開臉壓下不悅。艾薇直率拒絕在他們下方排練。尼洛要求先加第二道護欄，才准人探身過空隙。工人想丟棄破裂滑輪，騰地方放替換品，尼洛攔住他的手，改在零件下鋪編號布。木匠於是能數螺栓，不致把碎片掉進開放地板。阿筠把零件編號寫到暫停排練公告旁。

paragraphs.en: The theater’s superintendent offered an easy solution: dismiss the youngest stagehand and call the damage carelessness. Liora asked for the maintenance schedule instead. Three employees had reported a door left open at midnight, but the official log listed no entry. One witness had seen a shadow; another had heard a cart. Neither could identify the visitor. Liora ordered a physical demonstration of the route from the loading dock to the upper gallery and required all participants to wear their own numbered badges. A discharge notice showed that a former rigger had left under pressure. Liora promised to endeavor to contact him without exposing his address. The first hurdle was obtaining an unbiased measurement of the roof beams. The carpenter adjusted his posture before leaning over the dangerous rail.
paragraphs.zh: 劇院總監提供簡單辦法：解雇年紀最小的舞台工，並將損傷歸咎於疏忽。莉奧拉卻要求查閱維修時程。三名員工曾回報午夜有扇門敞開，官方紀錄卻沒有任何進出。有人看見影子，另一人聽見推車聲，沒有人能辨識訪客。莉奧拉下令實地重走從卸貨碼頭到高處走廊的路線，並規定參與者必須佩戴個人編號徽章。 一份解職通知顯示前任吊掛工曾在壓力下離職。 莉奧拉承諾努力聯絡他，同時不暴露住址。 第一個障礙是取得屋梁的公正測量結果。 木匠俯身越過危險欄杆前，先調整姿勢。

paragraphs.en: From the upper terrace, Nilo could follow the rope's full travel. Jun called out each position while the carpenter marked each bolt with precision. Their measurements put one support beyond the point shown on the official plan. The workers requested a rigorous test of that section before another load was hung. Downstairs, a newspaper seller called their vote an uprising. Liora carried the measurement sheet past him without answering. She needed the missing maintenance entry, so she asked the caretaker to show the loading route once more, this time with the numbered badges visible at every door.
paragraphs.zh: 從上層平台，尼洛能看見繩索移動的完整路徑。阿筠喊出各位置，木匠精確標出每顆螺栓。測量顯示，一處支架超出官方圖面的位置。工人要求再掛重物前，嚴格測試該部分。樓下報販把投票稱作起義，莉奧拉拿著測量單經過，沒有回答。她需要缺失的維護紀錄，於是請保管人再示範卸貨路線，這次每道門都讓編號徽章清楚可見。

paragraphs.en: On the stairs, Evi confronted her. A supervisor who had once threatened to replace dancers could not expect gratitude merely for preventing one accident. Liora admitted that Evi had no reason to trust her yet. She offered the company a vote on whether rehearsals should remain suspended until the report was finished. The dancers voted to wait. Corvin called the decision an insult to authority, but for the first time the people who stood beneath the scenery had changed the schedule themselves. A steward tried to usher Evi away before she could answer. Nilo was a versatile engineer who also knew the old theater’s history. Corvin threatened to veto the inspection budget, though he lacked that authority. A widower who had repaired the roof offered his original measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 在樓梯間，艾薇當面質問她。曾以換掉舞者威脅別人的監督，不能只因阻止一次事故就期待感激。莉奧拉承認艾薇沒有理由立刻信任她。她提議讓劇團投票，決定是否暫停排練到檢查結束。舞者投票選擇等待。科爾文稱這決定侮辱權威，但這是第一次由站在布景下的人親自改變時程。 一名管事試圖在艾薇回答前把她引走。 尼洛是多才多藝的工程師，也熟悉舊劇院歷史。 科爾文威脅否決檢查預算，但他沒有那項權限。 一名曾維修屋頂的鰥夫提供原始測量紀錄。

questions.question: Why is one photograph insufficient?
options: It proves who damaged the pulley.
It cannot show when the damage happened.
It shows that no one entered the theater.
questions.explanation: 照片無法確認滑輪何時被損壞。

questions.question: What choice do the performers make?
options: They accept Corvin’s schedule without discussion.
questions.explanation: 舞者投票在報告完成前暫停排練。

paragraphs.en: Jun took Liora through the costume workshops, which occupied a former hospital wing. Every seamstress knew the smell of hot iron, but yesterday’s smoke had come from a closed storage room, not the pressing tables. A charred strip of decorative fabric had been placed near a firework fuse. Jun had saved the strip because its weave differed from the cloth issued to the theater. Liora requested an examination from the textile guild and forbade anyone to announce arson before the guild had inspected both fibers. An advisory notice asked families to avoid the workshop during tests. Corvin described the festival as a conquest over the city’s gloomy past. Liora refused to allege a conspiracy before the fiber report arrived. The cook sliced cucumber for the children waiting outside the studio.
paragraphs.zh: 阿筠帶莉奧拉穿過戲服工坊；這裡原是醫院的一翼。每名縫紉師都熟悉熱熨斗的味道，但昨天的煙從上鎖儲藏間飄出，不是燙衣桌。有人把一條燒焦的裝飾布放在煙火引線附近。阿筠保存了布條，因為它的織法與劇院發放的布料不同。莉奧拉請紡織公會鑑定纖維，並禁止任何人在檢驗完成前公開宣稱有人縱火。 諮詢公告請家庭在測試期間避開工坊。 科爾文把節慶描述為對城市陰鬱過往的征服。 纖維報告出來前，莉奧拉拒絕指控有人陰謀串通。 廚師為等在工坊外的孩子切小黃瓜。

paragraphs.en: Jun found a feeble apprentice sitting beside the pressing tables and sent for medical help before asking him any questions. Behind the storage door, a line of black fume marked the ceiling. The inspector photographed the disconnected firecracker beneath the burnt cloth, then lifted its fuse with a clean tool. Grease stained the wrapping. Jun set an unopened workshop packet beside it for comparison; its wrapping was dry. Liora asked for both packets to be retained. The difference might help the guild trace the material, but it did not let her name whoever had carried it into the room.
paragraphs.zh: 阿筠看見虛弱學徒坐在熨燙桌旁，先叫醫護，沒急著問話。倉門後，黑色濃煙在天花板留下線痕。檢查員拍下焦布下斷開的鞭炮，再以乾淨工具提起引線。包裝有油脂。阿筠拿未開封工坊包裹作比較，那份包裝是乾的。莉奧拉要求兩份都保留。差異也許能幫公會追查材料，卻還不能讓她指認誰把東西帶進來。

paragraphs.en: Children from a nearby care home had been invited to sing at the coronation. Their teacher, Mara, said the organizer had moved the group beside the smoke exit without consulting her. Liora changed the route and asked the children what they understood about an emergency signal. One boy admitted that he had thought the red warning lantern was part of the play. The discovery shook Liora more than the scorched cloth. A safety rule no one could recognize was simply another decorative object. Opening the vents would lessen the smell without concealing the damaged cloth. Jun discovered a theater program liner containing the wrong safety instructions. The orphanage director demanded a separate evacuation practice for the children. One parent feared that smoke would spread like a plague through the old corridors.
paragraphs.zh: 附近安置機構的孩子受邀在加冕典禮歌唱。他們的老師瑪拉說，主辦人未經商量就把孩子安排在排煙出口旁。莉奧拉更改路線，並詢問孩子是否理解緊急訊號。一個男孩承認，他以為紅色警示燈只是戲劇的一部分。這項發現比燒焦布條更讓莉奧拉不安。無人認得的安全規則，根本只是另一件裝飾品。 打開通風口能減輕氣味，又不會掩蓋受損布料。 阿筠發現一張節目內頁印著錯誤安全指示。 育幼院院長要求為孩子安排獨立疏散練習。 一位家長擔心煙會像瘟疫般迅速蔓延舊走廊。

paragraphs.en: Mara began with recreational games so the youngest singers would listen before the evacuation practice. Jun replaced technical slang on the route card with simple directions, then asked a child to lead her to the marked door. He stopped at a shrub that narrowed the rear path. Liora had it cleared before the next group tried. A newspaper lay on the rehearsal bench, its savage portrait of her beside the guild's unanswered inquiry. She put the route card over it and watched the second child find the exit. This time he recognized the warning lantern and reached the door without prompting.
paragraphs.zh: 瑪拉先玩休閒遊戲，讓最小歌手在疏散練習前願意聽。阿筠把路線卡技術俚語換成簡單指示，請孩子帶她到標示門口。他被縮窄後路的灌木擋住，莉奧拉先清除，再讓下一組試。排練椅上有報紙，猛烈醜化她的肖像旁，是公會尚待回答的調查。她把路線卡放在報紙上，觀看第二名孩子找出口。這次他認出警示燈，沒人提示便到門口。

paragraphs.en: That evening a newspaper praised Corvin as the savior of public entertainment and described Liora as a vicious enemy of joy. The paper printed a portrait from the novel’s original illustration. She saw how the story had trained strangers to hate her before she could speak. Rather than demand a flattering portrait, she sent the newspaper the route-change notice and the guild’s receipt. Neither document proved who planted the fuse. Both proved that someone had begun reducing the danger. The new drill needed to surpass the previous one in clarity, not spectacle. A blue ribbon would symbolize an exit, never a fictional enemy. The textile guild promised an independent report on the scorched weave. The clinic confirmed that no child required a vaccine because of this smoke incident.
paragraphs.zh: 當晚報紙稱讚科爾文是公共娛樂的救星，卻說莉奧拉是快樂的惡毒敵人。報紙印出小說原版插圖中的肖像。她看見故事如何在她開口前，就訓練陌生人仇視她。她沒有要求改刊好看的照片，而是寄去動線更改通知與公會收據。這兩份文件都不能證明誰放置引線，卻能證明已有人的行動確實降低危險。 新演練必須在清晰度超越舊版，而非追求場面。 藍色緞帶象徵出口，絕不再被當成虛構敵人。 紡織公會承諾對燒焦的織紋提出獨立報告。 診所確認這次煙霧事件沒有孩子需要因此接種疫苗。

words.meaning: 野蠻的（帶有偏見的形容）

questions.question: What makes Jun keep the scorched cloth?
options: Its weave differs from the theater’s fabric.
questions.explanation: 布料織法不同，需要公會鑑定來源。

questions.question: What do the children misunderstand?
options: The meaning of the warning lantern.
questions.explanation: 孩子誤以為紅色警示燈是表演道具。

paragraphs.en: The orchestra had refused to rehearse because a low vibration reached the musicians whenever the main platform moved. Conductor Hale invited Liora beneath the stage, where an abandoned drainage channel ran past the old theater foundations. Water was seeping through a cracked wall. A brass marker showed that the platform’s lower support had once been part of a different building. Nilo suspected the recent renovation had concealed a hollow space, but he needed measurements to distinguish that possibility from ordinary settling. The crew used bleach only in an isolated cleaning area, never near the channel. Nilo requested a comprehensive map of every support beneath the orchestra pit. The landlady was a credible witness because she had preserved dated letters. Hale thanked the musicians for their dedication to keeping one another safe.
paragraphs.zh: 樂團拒絕排練，因為主舞台每次移動，樂手都會感到低沉的震動。指揮海爾邀莉奧拉走進舞台下方；一條廢棄排水道經過劇院舊地基，水從裂牆滲入。黃銅標記顯示舞台下部支撐原屬另一棟建築。尼洛懷疑最近的翻修掩蓋了一處中空空間，但他需要測量，才能將這個可能性與一般地基沉降區分。 工班只在隔離清潔區使用漂白水，不讓它接近水道。 尼洛要求一張涵蓋樂池下方所有支撐的完整地圖。 房東太太保存了註明日期的信，因此是可信的證人。 海爾感謝樂手致力彼此的安全。

paragraphs.en: The landlady led Jun behind the rental rooms, where a wooden dresser stood across the old access hatch. Jun asked for help moving it without dragging it over the weakened boards. The superintendent said the musicians' familiarity with the passage made a new inspection unnecessary. Liora asked him to open the hatch and show the engineer the water mark. He could not see it from the doorway. She invited the caretaker into the engineering discussion despite the usual hierarchy. The landlady put her damp envelope on the table, and Jun unfolded it under a dry cloth so the ink would not rub away.
paragraphs.zh: 房東太太帶阿筠到出租房後方，木製梳妝台擋著舊檢修口。阿筠請人幫忙搬，不在脆弱木板上拖行。總監說樂師熟悉通道，不必再檢查。莉奧拉請他開檢修口，讓工程師看水痕；從門邊根本看不見。她不依原有階級限制，邀保管人加入工程討論。房東太太把潮濕信封放在桌上，阿筠隔著乾布展開，避免墨跡磨掉。

paragraphs.en: A landlady who rented rooms to musicians remembered hearing the same noise during last spring’s storm. She had written to the former superintendent, who had replied that the sound was harmless. Liora located the letter and offered to preserve it without asking the woman to speculate about causes. The landlady cared less about court politics than about the tenants who walked home through the damp passage. She asked for a temporary barrier and a truthful public notice. Liora supplied both before returning to the technical questions. Outside, a lush courtyard hid the damaged drainage outlet from tourists. The orchestra gathered to mourn a former musician injured during renovation years ago. A patient mentor could nurture younger workers without demanding their silence. The engineer warned that overflow would reach the orchestra pit during heavy rain.
paragraphs.zh: 一名出租房間給樂手的房東太太記得，去年春季暴風雨也出現相同聲響。她曾寫信給前任劇院總監，得到的回覆卻說那聲音無害。莉奧拉找出信件，答應保存，同時不要求房東猜測原因。房東關心的不是宮廷政治，而是每天穿過潮濕通道回家的房客。她要求臨時圍欄及真實公告；莉奧拉先完成這兩項，再繼續討論技術問題。 外頭茂密的庭院把受損排水口藏在遊客視線外。 樂團聚在一起悼念多年前翻修時受傷的前團員。 有耐心的導師能培育年輕工人，不必要求他們噤聲。 工程師警告，大雨時溢流會進入樂池。

paragraphs.en: A violinist stopped Hale outside the pit. She had managed to overhear an instruction to block the drainage test, but could not identify the speaker. Liora recorded where she had stood and asked the contractor for the original order, giving him a chance to refute or confirm the account. The superintendent required a receipt before releasing the building keys. Jun wrote one with the room and return time. Outside, a seagull perched beside the flood gauge while Nilo checked the water level. The team could inspect the channel now; the disputed instruction would remain a separate question for the work-order review.
paragraphs.zh: 一名小提琴手在樂池外攔住海爾。她無意間聽見阻止排水測試的指示，卻認不出說話者。莉奧拉記下她站的位置，要求承包商出示原命令，讓他能反駁或確認。總監要求交鑰匙前先拿收據，阿筠寫明房間與歸還時間。外頭海鷗停在洪水刻度旁，尼洛核對水位。團隊如今可以檢查渠道，爭議指示則留給施工單審查，另外處理。

paragraphs.en: When the measurement team lowered a lantern into the channel, they discovered a new wooden brace fixed across an old drainage opening. Its nails bore the festival contractor’s mark. The brace could have been an emergency repair, or a shortcut that diverted water toward the foundations. Liora refused to call it either without the contractor’s work order. She had once mocked people who demanded paperwork. Now a missing work order might determine whether an entire audience could safely sit above the channel. Hale stopped the symphony at the first abnormal vibration. A thermometer showed the water below remained unusually cold after noon. The rumor caused turmoil among musicians whose rent was already overdue. The clinic prepared wholesome meals for workers on extended inspection duty.
paragraphs.zh: 測量隊把提燈放進水道時，發現一道新木撐架橫擋在舊排水口上，釘子刻有節慶承包商的標記。那可能是緊急修繕，也可能是把水導向地基的偷工捷徑。莉奧拉拒絕在拿到施工單前判定是哪一種。她過去曾嘲笑堅持留文件的人，如今一張缺失的施工單，卻可能決定整座觀眾席是否安全。 海爾在第一次出現異常震動時停止交響樂演奏。 溫度計顯示中午過後，下方積水仍異常冰冷。 謠言在房租早已逾期的樂手之間引發動盪。 診所為長時間值勤的檢查工人準備健康營養的餐點。

questions.question: What do the musicians report?
options: A vibration when the platform moves.
questions.explanation: 樂團發現主舞台移動時會產生低沉震動。

questions.question: Why does Liora request a work order?
options: To learn why the new brace was installed.
questions.explanation: 施工單有助於判定木撐架的用途與安裝原因。

paragraphs.en: A public safety panel met in the academy hall, where the festival contractor presented a polished drawing of a flawless stage. Liora arrived with damaged rope, fiber samples, drainage measurements, and statements from performers. She told the panel that none of these alone proved a coordinated attack. Together they proved the existing safety certificate was incomplete. Corvin argued that a delay would ruin the royal banquet and deprive merchants of business. Anet answered that merchants were not helped by a collapse in front of their customers. The academy offered a neutral hall for the public review hearing. An accusation appeared in the newspaper before the inspection report was finished. The royal banquet could continue indoors without activating the suspended platform. A merchant complained that spoiled fertilizer was blocking his market delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 公共安全小組在學院大廳開會，節慶承包商展示一張光鮮亮麗、毫無瑕疵的舞台圖。莉奧拉帶來損傷繩索、纖維樣本、排水測量，以及表演者陳述。她告訴小組，單一資料都無法證明串通破壞，但合在一起足以證明原有安全認證並不完整。科爾文辯稱延期會毀掉王室宴會，也讓商人失去生意。安妮特回答，若觀眾眼前發生坍塌，商人同樣得不到好處。 學院提供中立大廳舉行公開審查聽證。 檢查報告尚未完成，報紙就刊出指控。 王室宴會可以在室內繼續，無須啟動停用的平台。 一名商人抱怨變質肥料阻擋市場貨車通行。

paragraphs.en: Anet placed the support plank on two stands before the panel. Beneath its fresh paint, the fracture ran farther than Corvin's drawing showed. Nilo demonstrated the harness on an empty frame rather than send a worker up to satisfy the audience. The sound team supplied headphones so panel members could hear the recorded warning clearly. A merchant from the fishery asked how the shutdown would affect the loading dock. Anet marked a separate access route on the closure plan. The same plan could protect people beneath the platform and keep ordinary deliveries moving, provided neither route crossed the sealed test area.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮特把支撐木板放在兩座架上。新漆下的裂痕比科爾文圖中更長。尼洛在空架示範安全吊帶，沒有為滿足觀眾就派工人上去。音響團隊提供耳機，讓委員清楚聽見警告錄音。漁場商人問封閉如何影響卸貨碼頭，安妮特在封場圖另標通行路。只要兩條路都不穿過封存測試區，同一計畫可以保護平台下的人，也讓一般送貨繼續。

paragraphs.en: The panel granted a ten-day suspension of the dangerous machinery, not a permanent closure of the theater. The decision allowed work on costumes, music, and nonstructural scenery to continue. Liora accepted the limits and announced that the rehearsal calendar would be published each morning. The union would choose two inspectors, while a separate engineer would test the disputed loads. Jun smiled at the decision, then reminded her that unpaid wages remained unpaid. A safer theater was not yet a fair one. The clinic recorded the apprentice’s smoke intake without exaggerating his injury. The maiden performance of the new ballet was postponed rather than canceled. An offshore shipment contained replacement parts that had not passed local tests. Each prospective contractor received the same written inspection requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 小組裁定危險機械停用十日，而非永久關閉劇院。戲服、音樂與非承重布景仍可繼續。莉奧拉接受限制，宣布每天早晨公開排練日程。工會將選出兩名檢查員，另由獨立工程師測試有爭議的荷重。阿筠對裁定露出笑容，隨即提醒她，積欠的薪水依然沒有支付。更安全的劇院，還不代表更公平。 診所如實記錄學徒吸入煙霧的情形，不誇大傷勢。 新芭蕾舞劇的首次演出改期，而不是取消。 一批離岸運來的替換零件尚未通過本地測試。 每名有意承攬的廠商都收到相同書面檢查規定。

paragraphs.en: Outside the hall, Anet gathered the performers around a copy of the ten-day order. One man confused it with the proposed referendum on arts funding, so she pointed to the machinery number and read the limitation aloud. Nilo could refine the brake only after independent review; music and sewing could continue in the marked rooms. Several dancers began to rejoice, then Jun asked about wages for the canceled shifts. Liora wrote that question beneath the schedule rather than promise an answer she could not fund. She could understand why workers might resent her concern while their own rent remained unpaid.
paragraphs.zh: 廳外，安妮特讓表演者圍看十日命令。一人把它與藝術經費公投提案混淆，她指機械編號，唸出限制。尼洛須待獨立審查後才能改良煞車，音樂與裁縫可在標示房間繼續。幾名舞者歡喜起來，阿筠卻問取消班次的工資。莉奧拉把問題寫在行程下面，沒有承諾無法籌款的答案。她明白工人房租尚未付清，可能對她的關心感到怨恨。

paragraphs.en: On the palace steps, a clerk handed Liora a sealed invitation to a private meeting with Corvin. The envelope suggested that her family titles could be restored if she withdrew the complaint. She remembered how the original Liora had chosen status over everyone beneath her. This time she sent the offer to the panel as a possible conflict of interest and asked for the next hearing to be public. She knew that ten days would pass quickly. She also knew that the story’s fatal ending no longer seemed inevitable. The previously noisy hall grew serene as the panel read the final conditions. A local minister gave a sermon about sacrifice, but the dancers did not applaud. The stagehands had to shuffle their schedules to maintain the safe work zones. A tenant of the market asked that access rules be posted in plain language.
paragraphs.zh: 在王宮台階上，一名書記交給莉奧拉封緘的私下會面邀請。信暗示只要她撤回申訴，就能恢復家族頭銜。她記得原著中的莉奧拉曾選擇地位，而不是腳下所有人的安全。這一次，她把邀請轉交小組，作為可能的利益衝突證據，並要求下次聽證公開進行。她知道十天轉眼即逝，也知道故事裡那場致命結局不再像以前一樣不可避免。 小組宣讀最終條件時，原本吵鬧的大廳平靜下來。 一位地方牧師布道談論犧牲，舞者卻沒有鼓掌。 舞台工人不得不調整工作時程，維持安全工作區。 一位市場承租戶要求用淺白文字公告通行規則。

questions.question: What does the panel order?
options: Ten days without use of unsafe machinery.
questions.explanation: 小組准許危險機械停用十日，其餘安全工作可持續。

questions.question: How does Liora handle Corvin’s private offer?
options: She discloses it to the public panel.
questions.explanation: 她把私下邀請提交審查小組，要求公開處理。

paragraphs.en: A week into the suspension, posters appeared claiming that Liora intended to abolish the coronation. Their type matched the royal theater’s own print shop, although the shop had supposedly been closed. An apprentice printer showed Jun a discarded proof with a different message: the company had been ordered to present a new finale in which the villainess accepted responsibility for every failure. Liora recognized the scene from the novel, but the printed order was more useful than her memory. It carried the number of a live production account. The anonymous letter dared to allege that Liora wanted to ban the ceremony outright. Jun offered to beautify the old posters without changing their factual warnings. The poster caption falsely described the safety vote as a criminal rebellion. The playwright insisted that the original climax required a falling chandelier.
paragraphs.zh: 停用令進入第一週，街上出現海報，宣稱莉奧拉打算廢除加冕慶典。字型與王家劇院印刷坊相同，但坊間據稱早已關閉。一名印刷學徒給阿筠看遭丟棄的校樣，上面卻是另一段內容：劇團被要求演出新的終幕，讓惡女承擔所有失敗。莉奧拉認出小說裡的場景，但印刷命令比她的記憶更有用，因為上面有現行製作帳戶的編號。 匿名信指稱莉奧拉想全面禁止典禮。 阿筠提出美化舊海報，但不改動事實警告。 海報標題錯誤地把安全投票描述成犯罪叛亂。 劇作家堅稱原版高潮必須有吊燈墜落。

paragraphs.en: The pressman tried to sound jolly as he welcomed them, but his hand shook on the ledger clasp. His family remained hospitable, bringing stools into the cramped shop after hearing of the agent's threats. Jun asked where the discarded proof had lain before anyone moved it. The apprentice pointed to a tray shared with orders from an extracurricular drama club. Liora asked permission to extract the production account numbers, leaving the unrelated school orders covered. Jun wrote each copied number beside its page and asked the apprentice to check it. He corrected one digit that changed the account from costumes to publicity.
paragraphs.zh: 老印刷工努力開朗地招呼，手卻在帳簿扣上發抖。家人聽聞代理人威脅，仍熱情搬椅進狹小工坊。阿筠先問廢校樣原本在哪，學徒指向放有課外戲劇社訂單的紙盤。莉奧拉徵求同意擷取製作帳號，無關的學校訂單仍遮住。阿筠逐筆寫出抄錄號碼與頁碼，請學徒核對。他改正一個數字，帳戶類別便從戲服變成宣傳。

paragraphs.en: She asked the young printer to keep his own copy and to bring a guild representative to their next interview. Corvin’s agent arrived to demand the proofs, insisting the materials belonged to the palace. Liora answered that ownership did not erase a worker’s right to describe an instruction he had received. The agent left, but his departure was not victory. The print shop’s wages were paid through a subcontractor with the same address as the company repairing the damaged platform. A worker had to mow weeds behind the workshop to reveal its loading door. Corvin’s agent wore a theatrical false mustache that fooled no stagehand. Jun refused to nag frightened apprentices into making statements before they were ready. The break room felt like an oasis of calm amid the angry street protests.
paragraphs.zh: 她請年輕印刷工保留副本，下次接受訪談時帶公會代表同行。科爾文的代理人前來索取校樣，堅稱資料屬於王宮。莉奧拉回答，所有權不能抹除工人說明自己所接指示的權利。代理人離開了，但這不算勝利。印刷坊的工資由分包商支付，而那家公司的地址竟與修理受損平台的企業相同。 一名工人得先割去工坊後方雜草，才能露出卸貨門。 科爾文的代理人戴著假八字鬍，卻騙不了舞台工。 阿筠拒絕嘮叨催逼受驚學徒立即作證。 休息室在街頭激烈抗議中，像一片平靜綠洲。

paragraphs.en: A member of parliament arrived with the publicity contract, asking who had authorized its charge. The printer weighed an ounce of ink from the disputed batch and laid its supply ticket beside the proof. It connected that print run to a second shop on the outskirts, registered under another name. The apprentice took out a note warning him to surrender every copy. Its ruthless language had frightened him more than the agent's costume. Liora gave him a receipt for the copied note and asked the guild representative to arrange the next interview. The family kept the original ledger locked beneath the pressman's desk.
paragraphs.zh: 一名國會議員帶宣傳合約來，問誰核准費用。印刷工秤出爭議批次的一盎司油墨，把供應單放在校樣旁，將這批印件連到郊區另一間不同登記名的工坊。學徒拿出警告他交出所有副本的字條。殘酷措辭比代理人戲服更令他害怕。莉奧拉替字條副本開收據，請公會代表安排下次訪談。家人把原帳簿鎖在老印刷工桌下。

paragraphs.en: At dinner, Evi asked whether Liora intended to expose the entire production to protect herself. Liora replied that she wanted the company to continue, provided no one was required to risk a life in silence. The answer was harder to demonstrate than to say. She ordered a transparent ledger of the printing and repair contracts, then invited the workers to identify entries that did not match their hours. The first dispute concerned not treason but an apprentice who had never been paid for two nights of work. A sculptor who made stage figures recognized the printer’s distinctive paper. Liora preferred the simplicity of a signed receipt to a grand denial. The two payment requests had been filed on simultaneous dates at separate offices. The unpaid apprentice feared that another complaint would cause the shop’s business to slump.
paragraphs.zh: 晚餐時，艾薇問莉奧拉是否為了自保打算揭發整個製作計畫。莉奧拉回答，她希望劇團繼續，只是不該讓任何人在沉默中冒生命危險。說起來容易，證明卻難。她下令公開印刷與維修合約的帳目，請工人指出與工時不符的紀錄。第一項爭議不是叛國大罪，而是一名學徒兩個夜班的工錢從未收到。 製作舞台雕像的雕塑家認出印刷工使用的特殊紙張。 莉奧拉寧可相信簡單的簽收單，也不依賴誇大的否認。 兩份付款申請在相同日期送進不同辦公室。 未領薪的學徒擔心再次申訴會使商店生意下滑。

questions.question: What links the printing and repair companies?
questions.explanation: 印刷坊和平台維修分包商使用同一地址。

questions.question: What first appears in the wage audit?
questions.explanation: 帳目先查出一名學徒有兩個夜班未領薪。

paragraphs.en: The disputed pulleys came from a mountain mill whose owner had retired after a landslide. Liora traveled there with Nilo and the union inspector, avoiding a ceremonial escort that would frighten witnesses. The mill’s old ledger showed a small order for ordinary theater rope, but the palace invoice charged for reinforced cable. Its weight and price were different. The owner’s daughter had questioned the mismatch and was told to leave it alone. She handed over the ledger only after Liora agreed that the original would remain in her family’s custody. The mill family owned an acre of trees used to season replacement timber. The retired miller had been a bachelor when he began his craft, years before raising his daughter. A boxing club nearby offered its hall for a private witness interview. The contractor threatened disciplinary action against the daughter for refusing to sign.
paragraphs.zh: 有爭議的滑輪來自山區磨坊，老闆在一場土石流後退休。莉奧拉與尼洛及工會檢查員前往，刻意不用會嚇壞證人的儀仗隊。磨坊舊帳簿記載的是一小批普通劇場繩索，王宮發票卻以強化鋼索計費，重量和價格都不同。老闆的女兒曾質疑差異，卻被叫她別管。莉奧拉同意正本仍由家族保管後，她才交出帳簿供查驗。 磨坊家族有一英畝樹林，用來培養替換木料。 退休磨坊主是單身漢，把數十年奉獻給工藝。 附近的拳擊俱樂部提供場地進行私下證人訪談。 承包商威脅因女兒拒簽而採取紀律處分。

paragraphs.en: An emigrant worker met the visitors in the boxing hall and recalled the cart's weight from his last shift. Nilo asked him to describe how it handled on the slope before showing him either invoice. His account matched the lighter load in the mill ledger. When Corvin's representative entered, the daughter's voice began to falter. Liora asked the representative to wait outside until she had finished her account. She would not equate a disputed bill with sabotage. A farmer waiting to discuss soil fertility moved his meeting to the other room, leaving the daughter space to read her dates without an audience.
paragraphs.zh: 一名移居海外的工人在拳擊會館會見訪客，回憶最後一班時推車的重量。尼洛先請他描述斜坡上的車況，才給他看兩份發票。他的說法符合磨坊帳上的較輕負載。科爾文代表進來時，女兒聲音開始不穩。莉奧拉請代表在外面等，讓她先說完；爭議帳單不能等同蓄意破壞。等候討論土壤肥力的農夫把會議移到別室，留空間讓她不必當眾讀日期。

paragraphs.en: While Nilo compared the hardware, the daughter described pressure from the festival contractor to sign a new delivery date. She refused, because she remembered the day of a local funeral and knew the cart had not arrived. Liora asked her to explain the memory without turning it into an exact clock time. The three visitors could verify the ledger with shipping weights and toll receipts. By afternoon they had established that the royal invoice described materials the mill had never supplied. Nilo promised not to forsake the witness if the contractor retaliated. The miller spoke of a gay, carefree festival from his youth. A long gloom settled over the workshop when the altered bill was shown. The toll receipt came from the intersection where the valley road divided.
paragraphs.zh: 尼洛比較零件時，女兒說節慶承包商曾施壓，要她簽署新的交貨日期。她拒絕了，因為記得那天村裡辦喪事，貨車根本沒來。莉奧拉請她說明記憶，卻不要求說出無法確定的時刻。三名訪客可利用運輸重量和道路收費收據交叉核對帳簿。到了下午，他們證明王宮發票上所列的材料，磨坊根本沒有供應。 尼洛承諾承包商若報復，也不會拋棄證人。 磨坊主說起年輕時一場歡樂無憂的節慶。 修改過的帳單亮出後，工坊陷入長久陰鬱。 收費收據來自谷地道路分岔的交叉口。

paragraphs.en: The daughter unfolded the toll receipts along the ledger's edge. The earlier landslide had closed the southern road for nearly three weeks, including the new delivery date she had been asked to sign. Nilo traced the open northern route and compared its recorded weight with the invoice. The miller's orthodox habit of keeping every receipt let them follow the shipment without guessing. He offered to nourish the visitors with bread while certified copies were prepared. Corvin's representative claimed the family could not submit private books. Liora asked him to identify a prohibition in the panel's rules. He found none, and the daughter kept the original open for certification.
paragraphs.zh: 女兒沿帳簿邊攤開過路收據。早先山崩使南路封閉近三週，包含別人要求她簽的新送貨日。尼洛追出仍開放的北路，把登記重量與發票比對。磨坊主人保留每張收據的傳統習慣，讓他們不用猜就能追貨。他在準備認證副本時拿麵包款待訪客。科爾文代表說家人不能提交私人帳簿，莉奧拉請他指出委員會規則的禁令。他找不到，女兒便繼續攤開原件辦理認證。

paragraphs.en: The discovery did not identify who had altered the invoice. A careless accountant and a dishonest contractor could leave the same difference on paper. Liora paid for certified copies and arranged for the mill to speak at the next hearing, with travel costs covered regardless of testimony. On the return journey, Nilo admitted that he had once dismissed the mill as old-fashioned. He now understood that the family’s refusal to replace its ledger had protected everyone onstage. A provisional receipt recorded the transfer of copies, not the original ledger. The three visitors were unanimous about what the weight records established. Liora set aside her vanity and thanked the daughter for correcting her assumptions. A woodpecker tapped on the beam outside as the final signatures were made.
paragraphs.zh: 這項發現還不能指出是誰改了發票。粗心會計和不誠實承包商，都可能在紙上留下同樣差異。莉奧拉付費取得認證副本，安排磨坊代表出席下次聽證，不論證詞內容都支付交通費。回程路上，尼洛承認自己曾嫌這座磨坊落伍，如今才明白，家人堅持不更換舊帳簿的決定保護了舞台上的所有人。 臨時收據記錄副本交接，正本沒有移動。 三名訪客對重量紀錄所能證明的事情意見一致。 莉奧拉放下虛榮，感謝女兒糾正自己的假設。 最後簽名時，一隻啄木鳥在窗外木樑上啄擊。

questions.question: What mismatch do the investigators find?
options: The invoice lists materials the mill did not supply.
questions.explanation: 發票記載強化材料，但磨坊帳簿並未供應。

questions.question: Who keeps the original mill ledger?
questions.explanation: 莉奧拉同意正本仍留在磨坊家族。

paragraphs.en: The cast discovered that the new final scene required Evi to stand beneath the moving chandelier while the audience sang. The director insisted the position was symbolic and therefore safe. Evi pointed out that symbols did not change gravity. She and several dancers petitioned for a different ending, not a smaller part. Liora promised them a rehearsal under stationary scenery where they could test the dramatic effect without the dangerous machinery. The director protested that only the original ending could move the royal audience. The accumulation of petitions made the director realize the cast would not retreat. Jun offered a warm beverage before the exhausting open rehearsal. A blonde dancer volunteered to demonstrate the new opening movement. The structural engineer refused to certify moving scenery without a load test.
paragraphs.zh: 演員發現新終幕要求艾薇站在移動的吊燈下，聽全場觀眾歌唱。導演堅稱那個位置具有象徵意義，所以是安全的。艾薇指出，象徵不會改變重力。她和數名舞者連署要求更換結局，不是縮小自己的角色。莉奧拉承諾讓他們在固定布景下排練，測試戲劇效果而不動用危險機械。導演抗議，說只有原版結局能感動王室觀眾。 連署書逐漸累積，讓導演明白演員不會退縮。 阿筠在疲憊的公開排練前提供熱飲。 一名金髮舞者自願示範新的開場動作。 結構工程師拒絕在未測試荷重前認證移動布景。

paragraphs.en: Evi asked the director to walk the route to every emergency exit before the stationary rehearsal. The company wanted written clearance, not his assurance from the stage. A clerk threatened to deduct their wages for signing the petition. Jun wrote down the threat and asked which rule authorized it. The clerk lowered his paper. Evi then moved the youngest dancers away from the lamp's marked position. Nobody was destined to die there, she said, whatever the script required. Jun shortened the repeated movements so the long practice would not exert needless pressure on injured knees. The director watched the cast prepare without touching the machinery.
paragraphs.zh: 靜態排練前，艾薇請導演實走每條緊急出口路線。劇團要的是書面通行許可，不是他站台上的保證。書記威脅因連署扣薪，阿筠記下威脅，問哪條規則准許。書記放低紙張。艾薇把最小舞者移離燈具標示位置，說無論劇本怎麼寫，沒人注定死在那裡。阿筠減少重複動作，避免長時間練習對受傷膝蓋施加不必要壓力。導演看著演員不碰機械，自行準備。

paragraphs.en: In an open rehearsal, Evi stepped out of the sacrificial circle before the music stopped. The other dancers followed her, leaving the lamp alone at center stage. Silence fell, then the younger audience members began to applaud. Jun proposed that the circle represent a choice no one had the right to impose. Liora recognized that the revision challenged the very story which had trapped her. It also gave the performers a reason to participate in protecting the new production. One critic called Evi heroic, but she asked for ordinary protections instead. A retired lieutenant offered to organize the audience without armed guards. The revised program was written plainly enough for a literate young reader. A painted lotus replaced the image of the sacrificial flame.
paragraphs.zh: 公開排練時，艾薇在音樂停止前走出象徵犧牲的圓圈。其他舞者跟上，只留下吊燈獨自在舞台中央。全場先是一片寂靜，接著年輕觀眾開始鼓掌。阿筠提議，圓圈象徵任何人都無權強迫別人承擔的選擇。莉奧拉明白這項修改正在挑戰把自己困住的故事，也讓表演者有理由參與保護新的製作。 一名評論家稱艾薇英勇，她卻只要求基本保護。 一名退役中尉提出不靠武裝衛兵維持觀眾秩序。 修改後的節目單文字清楚，識字的年輕讀者都能理解。 彩繪蓮花取代象徵犧牲火焰的圖像。

paragraphs.en: The director called the dancers' objection marginal and opened a rehearsal calendar to prove they had no time. Jun marked where the groups' schedules overlap: only the final scene required everyone together. A provincial troupe had offered another hall for the earlier sections, freeing that hour for the revised ending. Evi tried the first movement there, then invited another actor to take her place. His qualification would be his skill, she told the director, not whether he obeyed an unsafe instruction. They could disagree about the scene's meaning while using the same stationary marks on the floor. Jun penciled the new room beside each group's call time.
paragraphs.zh: 導演說舞者異議無關主線，打開排練表，想證明沒時間。阿筠標出各組時段重疊處，只有終幕需要全員。外省劇團願借另一廳給前段排練，於是能空出這一小時改結尾。艾薇在那裡試第一個動作，再邀另一演員接替。她告訴導演，資格在技巧，不在是否服從不安全指示。他們可以對場景意義有不同意見，同時使用地上同樣固定的標記。阿筠在各組集合時間旁寫下新房間。

paragraphs.en: After the rehearsal, a palace courier delivered notice that the revised choreography lacked the royal artistic seal. Corvin wanted the company to confuse artistic approval with permission to ignore safety rules. Liora separated the two: the cast would seek artistic review while maintaining its refusal to use the unsafe device. She told Evi that even a successful petition might lead to her dismissal. Evi answered that she would rather lose a role than teach the youngest dancers that obedience was the price of living. The theater sold refreshments in the lobby while the rehearsal continued. Jun could retrieve the original costume sketches from the locked cabinet. A shallow swamp beyond the outer gate would be closed during the festival. Evi said dancing was a vocation, not a promise to abandon her own life.
paragraphs.zh: 排練後，一名王宮信差送來通知，稱新編舞沒有獲得王室藝術印章。科爾文想讓劇團把藝術核准與忽視安全規則混為一談。莉奧拉把兩者分開：演員會申請藝術審查，同時維持拒絕使用危險設備的決定。她告訴艾薇，連署成功仍可能導致被解雇。艾薇回答，她寧可失去角色，也不願教最年輕的舞者把服從當成活命的代價。 排練期間，劇院在大廳販售點心飲料。 阿筠能從上鎖櫃子取回原始戲服草圖。 外門外的淺沼澤在節慶期間將封閉。 艾薇說舞蹈是志業，不是放棄生命的承諾。

questions.question: What does Evi change in the rehearsal?
options: She walks out of the sacrificial circle.
questions.explanation: 艾薇在音樂停止前走出象徵犧牲的圓圈。

questions.question: Which two approvals does Liora separate?
questions.explanation: 藝術核准不能替代舞台安全許可。

paragraphs.en: The printing apprentice returned with a second set of payment receipts. Their numbers matched the theatrical accounts, but the dates belonged to the month before the safety renovation was authorized. Someone had reserved funds before the work existed. Liora did not assume that a premature payment proved fraud; advance orders were common. Instead she asked which goods had been purchased and who had signed for delivery. The ledger contained a sequence of small charges made to a silent partnership called the Laurel House. Liora did not want to alienate tenants by publishing their private addresses. A dark blot of ink hid the original date on one repair invoice. The café served chili soup while Anet organized the meeting. The ledger’s continuity could be checked across successive monthly pages.
paragraphs.zh: 印刷學徒帶回第二組付款收據。編號與劇院帳目相符，日期卻落在安全翻修獲准的前一個月。有人在工程尚不存在時就預留資金。莉奧拉沒有認定提前付款就代表詐欺；預先訂貨並不少見。她改問購買了哪些商品，以及由誰簽收。帳簿記載一連串小額費用，都支付給一間名叫桂冠屋的隱名合夥組織。 莉奧拉不想因公開私人住址而疏遠承租戶。 一塊深色墨漬遮住一張維修發票的原始日期。 安妮特召集會議時，咖啡館供應辣椒湯。 帳簿的連續性可由逐月頁面交叉檢驗。

paragraphs.en: Anet added the charges in front of the tenants. The cumulative total passed the approved repair amount before she reached the final page. Jun pointed out two work entries that belonged to costume staff rather than the publicity firm. She was not dispensable to the inquiry because her own name was absent from the invoices; she could explain whose work they described. Liora asked for the ownership filings before drawing a decisive conclusion. Through the window, jasmine beside the meeting room hid the waiting guards from view. Anet shut the curtain and gave each tenant a separate page on which to identify only the charges they knew.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮特當租戶面加總費用，還沒到最後一頁，累計已超過核准修理額。阿筠指出兩筆屬於戲服人員的工作，不是宣傳公司。發票沒她姓名，不代表調查能省略她，因為她能說明費用描述誰的工作。莉奧拉要求先查所有權登記，再下決定性結論。窗外茉莉遮住等候衛兵。安妮特拉簾，給每位租戶分開的一頁，只標自己知道的費用。

paragraphs.en: Anet organized a public meeting with the market tenants, many of whom worked for festival subcontractors. They reported the same pattern: a business signed an agreement, a different business issued the invoice, and a third collected the payment. None of the tenants knew who controlled Laurel House. Liora requested the registry’s ownership filings and promised not to publish private home addresses. She understood that evidence gathered without care could harm the very people she wanted to protect. A caretaker let the visitors lodge their records in a lockable cupboard. A maple cabinet held older contracts from the theater’s first renovation. The former mistress of Laurel House had kept detailed household accounts. Anet worked to mobilize the tenants without telling them how to vote.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮特召集市場承租戶開會，其中許多人替節慶分包商工作。他們回報相同模式：一家商號簽約、另一家開發票、第三家收款。沒人知道誰掌控桂冠屋。莉奧拉要求查看公司登記的所有權資料，並承諾不公開私人住址。她明白，不慎蒐集證據也可能傷害她原本想保護的人。 一名看守讓訪客把紀錄存放在可上鎖的櫃子。 楓木櫃收藏著劇院第一次翻修時的舊合約。 桂冠屋的前女主人曾保存詳盡家用帳冊。 安妮特努力動員承租戶，但不指示他們如何投票。

paragraphs.en: The apprentice's persistence persuaded the registry clerk to bring the earlier filing book. A date there preceded the repair authorization, just as the receipts did. Liora began to muse on who might have noticed the overlap sooner, then stopped and copied the entry instead. A socialist delegate asked how citizens could scrutinize the public payments. Anet showed him the account page while keeping home addresses covered. The tenants chose to socialize after the formal meeting, away from palace guards. Liora stayed at the table with the clerk long enough to mark which ownership documents were still missing. The new dates narrowed the inquiry; they did not identify a rope cutter.
paragraphs.zh: 學徒鍥而不捨，終於讓登記書記拿出較早的登記簿。裡頭一個日期也像收據般早於修理核准。莉奧拉開始思索，誰本可更早注意到重疊，隨即停下，改抄條目。一名社會主義代表問市民如何監督公款，安妮特讓他看帳頁，仍蓋住住址。租戶選擇正式會議後遠離衛兵交談。莉奧拉陪書記留在桌邊，標出還缺哪些所有權文件。新日期縮小調查範圍，並未找出割繩者。

paragraphs.en: The ownership register revealed that Laurel House leased warehouses but owned no theater equipment. Its director was Corvin’s stepbrother, a fact he had not disclosed at the first hearing. This did not prove the director had cut a rope; it did establish that a private beneficiary had been absent from the public discussion. Liora submitted the finding with a request for Corvin to step aside from approving future repair invoices. His answer arrived within an hour: she would be removed as supervisor if she continued. The disputed invoices span three accounting periods rather than a single week. Two tenants had made the long trek from the northern wards to attend. Their vigorous questions forced the officials to explain each transfer. All copies went into a waterproof case before the rain began.
paragraphs.zh: 所有權登記顯示桂冠屋租賃倉庫，卻沒有劇院設備。董事是科爾文的繼兄弟，這層關係在第一次聽證中未揭露。這不代表董事切斷繩索，卻證明公共討論漏掉一名可能私下獲利的人。莉奧拉提交結果，要求科爾文迴避日後維修發票的審核。他一小時內就答覆：她若繼續追查，就將失去監督職位。 有爭議的發票橫跨三個會計期間，而非一週。 兩名承租戶從北區長途跋涉前來出席。 他們積極有力的提問迫使官員解釋每筆轉帳。 下雨前所有副本都放進防水箱。

questions.question: Why does Liora investigate Laurel House?
options: Its unexplained charges appear in the theater accounts.
questions.explanation: 桂冠屋在劇院帳上出現多筆尚待說明的費用。

questions.question: What does the ownership register establish?
options: That the dancers caused the accident.
questions.explanation: 登記資料證實科爾文與受款企業有未揭露的關係。

paragraphs.en: The temporary permit expired at midnight, and the city allowed one preview using a stationary set. Corvin arrived with inspectors of his own and promised an audience of ministers. Liora asked that the independent engineer’s conditions be read aloud before the doors opened. The company moved the dangerous chandelier into a locked workshop and replaced it with a painted shadow. Critics called the substitute plain, but Evi said that people had come to watch living dancers, not to witness the weight of a machine. The new permit was a limited concession, not full approval of the machinery. A cynical critic said safety rules would bore every royal guest. The contractor had failed by default to submit the required maintenance plan. Emergency supplies would deplete quickly if spectators blocked the exit.
paragraphs.zh: 臨時許可在午夜到期，市府准許用固定布景舉行一次預演。科爾文帶著自己的人員前來，承諾大臣會到場。莉奧拉要求開門前公開宣讀獨立工程師的條件。劇團把危險吊燈移進上鎖工坊，改用彩繪陰影代替。評論家嫌替代品平淡，艾薇卻說觀眾是來看活生生的舞者，不是來見證機器的重量。 新許可是有限度讓步，不是對機械全面核准。 一名憤世嫉俗的評論家說安全規則會讓王室賓客無聊。 承包商因未提交必要維修計畫而構成程序違約。 若觀眾堵住出口，緊急物資會很快耗盡。

paragraphs.en: Before the preview, the fragrance of fresh paint drifted from the lobby into the witness room. Liora asked guards not to intrude there while the inspector spoke to workers. Outside, a visiting jockey described how a sudden whistle could startle a horse or a person expecting music. Jun checked that the company knew the agreed stop signal before admitting the royal guests. The director read the stationary-set condition in its literal sense and ordered the old device left in the workshop. Evi tested her path around the painted shadow. Nothing on that route required a worker to step beneath a hanging lamp.
paragraphs.zh: 試演前，新漆香味從大廳飄進證人室。檢查員與工人交談時，莉奧拉請衛兵不要闖入。外面一名來訪騎師說，突來哨聲會驚動馬，也會嚇到本來期待音樂的人。阿筠先確認劇團認得約定停演訊號，才讓王室來賓入場。導演按字面遵守靜態布景條件，命舊裝置留在工坊。艾薇測試繞過彩繪陰影的路線，整條路都不必走到懸燈下。

paragraphs.en: Halfway through the performance, an unfamiliar whistle sounded from the service corridor. The stagehands stopped the scene under their agreed procedure. No one ran, and the emergency exits remained clear. Investigators found a visitor’s badge beside a cabinet that held the old pulley. It had no assigned name. Liora preserved the badge but refused the palace officer’s suggestion that it proved the union had staged the interruption. The company restarted only after the service corridor was cleared. The workers’ morale improved when their refusal was respected. A palace official threatened to prosecute whoever had stopped the music. Nilo confirmed that no radioactive substance was present in the old stage paint. Evi did not retort angrily; she pointed to the agreed emergency rules.
paragraphs.zh: 演到一半，服務走廊傳出陌生哨音。舞台工依先前議定的程序停止演出。沒有人奔跑，緊急出口也保持暢通。調查人員在存放舊滑輪的櫃子旁找到一張訪客證，上面沒有使用者姓名。莉奧拉保存證件，卻拒絕王宮官員的說法——證件不能證明工會自導自演。服務走廊清場後，劇團才重新開始。 工人拒絕危險工作獲尊重後，士氣有所提升。 王宮官員威脅起訴讓音樂停止的人。 尼洛確認舊舞台油漆沒有放射性物質。 艾薇沒有憤怒頂嘴，而是指向事先同意的應變規則。

paragraphs.en: After the whistle stopped the scene, Nilo found a screwdriver beneath the cabinet near the nameless badge. He asked the inspector to photograph both before either was lifted. In the lobby, the café gave a serving of soup to each worker waiting through the corridor search. Evi stayed by the stationary backdrop, whose painted splendor had replaced the glass. When the inspector cleared the route, she returned to her opening mark. The first applause was spontaneous; no usher had prompted it. Liora wrote the interruption time on the permit copy and asked for the restart time to be recorded beside it.
paragraphs.zh: 哨聲使場景停止後，尼洛在無名徽章旁的櫃下找到螺絲起子，請檢查員先拍下兩件位置，再提起。大廳咖啡攤給等候走廊搜索的每名工人一份湯。艾薇留在靜態背幕旁，彩繪華麗取代了玻璃。檢查員確認路線無礙，她回到起始標記。第一陣掌聲自發響起，沒有接待員帶頭。莉奧拉在許可副本寫下中斷時間，請人把重開時間記在旁邊。

paragraphs.en: The preview ended to uncertain applause. Some spectators admired the revised ending; others complained that a coronation should not include doubt. Liora counted the result differently. Not one performer had stood beneath untested equipment, and the interruption had been handled without injury. The anonymous badge would require investigation, but it had not been allowed to become an instant conviction. The original novel promised a glamorous tragedy. Her new version offered a smaller achievement: everyone went home alive. Evi’s stepfather watched from the back row and respected her choice. A nervous singer began to stutter when questioned by armed guards. The city agreed to subsidize public tickets only if safety terms were met. The team used synthetic cloth for the shadow instead of heavy glass ornaments.
paragraphs.zh: 預演在猶豫的掌聲中結束。有些觀眾喜歡修改後的結局，另一些抱怨加冕典禮不該留下疑惑。莉奧拉用另一種方式計算成果：沒有人站在未測試設備下，意外中止也沒有造成傷害。無名訪客證仍須追查，卻沒有立即成為定罪的藉口。原著承諾華麗的悲劇，而她的新版本只取得一項較小的成就：所有人都活著回家。 艾薇的繼父坐在後排觀賞，尊重她的選擇。 一名緊張的歌手遭武裝衛兵盤問時開始結巴。 市府同意只有符合安全條件才補助公共票券。 團隊以合成纖維布製作陰影，不再使用沉重玻璃裝飾。

questions.question: What replaces the unsafe chandelier?
questions.explanation: 劇團以彩繪陰影代替危險吊燈。

questions.question: Why is the preview counted as progress?
options: The safety interruption ends without injury.
questions.explanation: 舞台工依程序安全停演，沒有人受傷。

paragraphs.en: A sound technician traced the strange whistle to an old signal pipe built into the theater wall. The pipe had been designed to warn fire crews, but its handle was hidden behind a newly installed panel. No visitor could have reached it from the audience seats. Liora ordered a reconstruction with the technician, the caretaker, and a neutral observer. When they pulled the handle from the service side, the exact sound from the preview returned. Someone familiar with the building had caused the interruption, although the motive remained unclear. The instrument recorded twenty-one degrees Celsius inside the service passage. Repeated friction had darkened the edge of the hidden signal handle. A guard began to growl when the technician requested another demonstration. Liora refused to induce Brin to accuse someone she had not seen.
paragraphs.zh: 音響技術員追查奇怪哨音，發現那是藏在劇院牆內的一條舊訊號管。它原本用來警告消防工班，操作把手卻被新裝的面板遮住。觀眾席上的訪客根本不可能碰到。莉奧拉請技術員、看守與中立觀察員重演。當他們從服務通道拉下把手，預演時的哨聲原樣重現。有人熟悉建築內部才會引發中斷，但動機仍不清楚。 儀器記錄服務走廊內攝氏二十一度。 反覆摩擦讓隱藏訊號把手的邊緣變黑。 技術員要求再示範一次時，衛兵不滿地低吼。 莉奧拉拒絕誘導布琳指控她沒有看見的人。

paragraphs.en: The technician asked the caretaker to leave the dust beneath the new panel untouched. A small mound showed where the edge had scraped the wall. Insects might inhabit the unused shaft, he explained, but they could not make the recorded tone. He pulled the handle with the observer watching and let the exact whistle answer him. It was ironic to hear the old warning device again after so much fear. Outside, a peacock called from the palace courtyard. Jun asked the technician to repeat the pipe sound alone so there would be no doubt which noise belonged on their recording.
paragraphs.zh: 技術員請保管人別碰新面板下的灰塵，小土堆顯出邊緣刮牆的位置。他說昆蟲也許住在閒置井道，卻不能發出錄音裡的音調。見證人看著他拉把手，完全相同的哨音響起。經過這麼多驚恐，再聽見舊警告裝置，格外諷刺。外頭王宮庭院孔雀叫了。阿筠請技術員單獨重複管音，免得日後分不清錄音裡哪個聲音屬於它。

paragraphs.en: A kitchen worker named Brin confessed that she had heard the whistle once before, during a private demonstration for Corvin’s staff. She had not mentioned it because her husband worked for the same contractor. Liora promised that Brin’s testimony would not be treated as proof that her husband had done anything wrong. Instead, they compared demonstration dates with work orders and the service gate log. An entry showed the signal panel had been installed without being added to the public safety plan. The rehearsal pianist recognized the whistle from an earlier private demonstration. The inspector used a narrow probe to examine the pipe without breaking it. The respective roles of the technician and caretaker were written down clearly. Corvin’s shortsighted demand for secrecy had made the alarm less useful.
paragraphs.zh: 廚房工人布琳坦承，她曾在科爾文員工的私人示範裡聽過同一種哨音。她先前沒說，因為丈夫也替同一家承包商工作。莉奧拉承諾，不會把布琳的證詞當成她丈夫犯罪的證據。他們改比對示範日期、施工單與服務門紀錄。其中一筆記載顯示訊號面板已被安裝，卻從未加進公開安全計畫。 排練鋼琴師認出那是先前私人示範聽到的哨音。 檢查員用細探針檢查管道，避免破壞。 技術員與看守各自的職責都清楚記錄。 科爾文短視地要求保密，讓警報更難發揮作用。

paragraphs.en: Jun helped simplify the pipe diagram for Brin, who knew the kitchen route but not the engineers' room names. Brin placed her finger beside the service door where she had heard the earlier demonstration. The nearby strait carried the theater horn's sound on clear nights, but this pipe ended inside the building. Nilo followed its line behind the panel's superficial paint and noted the newer hinges. Liora asked the clerk to preserve Brin's marked copy. She would not suppress it because the demonstration involved palace staff. The contractor could answer with an authorization, but an unsigned page could not do that work for him.
paragraphs.zh: 阿筠幫忙簡化管線圖，讓熟悉廚房路線、不熟工程房名的布琳看。布琳指著勤務門，先前示範時她就在那裡聽見聲音。附近海峽晴夜可傳劇院號角，這根管卻止於建築內。尼洛沿面板表層油漆後的管線追查，記下較新鉸鏈。莉奧拉請書記保存布琳標記的圖，不會因涉及王宮人員示範就壓下。承包商可拿授權回應，但未簽頁面不能替他做到。

paragraphs.en: The panel could still have been installed as a misguided emergency improvement, so Liora asked for the instruction that authorized it. The contractor produced a page with a blank signature field. Corvin wanted to treat the page as sufficient proof of permission. Liora rejected the shortcut and sent the question to the city inspector. Meanwhile the company made the old pipe visible on the safety map so no worker would mistake its sound for a stage effect again. The pipes lacked the symmetry shown on the official plan. A brass token identified the key issued for the signal cabinet. The union agreed to unify the warning signals across every rehearsal room. A sense of urgency guided the repair, but no one skipped the signed checks.
paragraphs.zh: 那面板仍可能只是用錯方法的應急改善，因此莉奧拉要求查閱核准安裝的指示。承包商交出一張簽名欄空白的文件。科爾文想把它當成已獲許可的證明，莉奧拉拒絕這個捷徑，把問題交給市府檢查員。同時劇團把舊訊號管標在安全圖上，讓工人以後不會再把哨音當成舞台效果。 管道排列缺少官方圖面所示的對稱性。 黃銅代幣標明訊號櫃鑰匙的領用編號。 工會同意統一各排練室的警示訊號。 修復很緊急，卻沒有人略過簽署查核。

questions.question: Where does the whistle come from?
options: An old signal pipe behind a panel.
questions.explanation: 聲音來自新面板後方的舊消防訊號管。

questions.question: Why is the contractor’s paper insufficient?
questions.explanation: 文件簽名欄空白，無法證明已獲正式核准。

paragraphs.en: The playwright’s widow invited Liora to inspect the original script after hearing the revised finale. She lived near the inner canal and guarded her husband’s papers fiercely. In the margins of his first draft, he had written that the heroine’s survival should depend on choosing solidarity over spectacle. Later versions reversed that ending and made the young dancer’s death appear noble. The widow had correspondence showing that the changes came from Corvin’s office, although the letters did not explain why the patron wanted them. The widow lived beside a brook that fed the old city canal. A coral ornament decorated the cover of the first manuscript. Liora would not deprive the widow of custody over her husband’s original pages. The older ending could elevate the dancers rather than glorify their deaths.
paragraphs.zh: 劇作家的遺孀聽說改寫終幕後，邀莉奧拉查看原稿。她住在內運河旁，極力保護丈夫留下的紙張。第一稿頁邊寫著：女主角能否活下來，取決於她是否選擇團結而非場面。後來版本顛倒結局，把年輕舞者的死亡寫成高尚行為。遺孀保留了往來信件，顯示修改要求來自科爾文辦公室，但沒有說明贊助人為何如此執著。 遺孀住在注入舊城運河的小溪旁。 第一份手稿封面有珊瑚裝飾。 莉奧拉不會剝奪遺孀保管丈夫手稿正本的權利。 舊結局能提升舞者的地位，而不是歌頌他們死亡。

paragraphs.en: The widow held an old letter close, then passed it back to Liora. Its expiration date concerned permission for one production, not the destruction of the first draft. Because her eyesight was fading, Jun enlarged the disputed margin before asking her to read it. The widow corrected one copied word and served a hearty lunch while they waited for the licensing papers. Near the canal, a paper lantern seemed to hover in the mist. Liora looked from its harmless light to the manuscript's later stage direction and asked when the heavy moving lamp had first entered the play.
paragraphs.zh: 遺孀把舊信拿近眼前，再交回莉奧拉。到期日限制的是一次演出授權，不是銷毀初稿。她視力衰退，阿筠先放大爭議頁邊，才請她讀。遺孀改正一個抄錯的字，等授權文件時招待豐盛午餐。運河旁紙燈籠像浮在霧裡。莉奧拉看看無害燈光，再看手稿後期舞台指示，問沉重活動燈具究竟何時加入戲中。

paragraphs.en: Nilo compared the first script with the technical plan. The fatal scene had originally required no moving weight at all. Its emotional center was an empty space where the dancers refused the command to sacrifice a member. The mechanical chandelier appeared only in a later artistic revision, at the same time the stage renovation budget expanded. Liora did not treat this as evidence of a murder plot. She treated it as a meaningful overlap between financial and creative decisions, one that required a clear explanation. The playwright had traveled inland to interview dancers before writing the first act. Evi admired the widow’s insistence that the cast approve any new use. The older license resembled a lease of rights, not a sale of the pages. A legislator had once praised the playwright for defending public theaters.
paragraphs.zh: 尼洛把初稿和技術圖面比較。原本的致命場景根本沒有任何移動重物，戲劇核心是一塊空地：舞者集體拒絕犧牲同伴的命令。機械吊燈直到後來的藝術修訂才出現，時間恰好與舞台翻修預算擴大重疊。莉奧拉沒有把這視為謀殺陰謀的證據，而是當成財務和創作決策可疑的重合點，必須獲得清楚解釋。 劇作家寫第一幕前曾到內陸訪談舞者。 艾薇欣賞遺孀堅持新使用方式須經演員同意。 舊授權像是權利租約，而非出售手稿。 一名立法者曾稱讚劇作家維護公共劇院。

paragraphs.en: Under the monarch's portrait, the widow set the first scenery drawing beside the revised song. It showed a majestic stairway with no moving glass above it. Evi read the final refrain quietly, then invited the others to join. The song gathered momentum as each voice entered without a signal from Liora. The playwright's offspring confirmed that they had no objection to the limited educational license, but the widow still asked the performers for their own answer. Jun wrote down their proposed changes on a separate sheet. The fragile original remained on its stand while the living cast began making a working script.
paragraphs.zh: 君主肖像下，遺孀把最初布景圖放在修改歌曲旁。圖上有雄偉階梯，上方卻無活動玻璃。艾薇輕讀最後疊句，邀其他人加入。每個聲音自行加入，歌曲漸有力量，沒有等莉奧拉發訊號。劇作家子女確認不反對有限教學授權，遺孀仍要問表演者自己的答案。阿筠把修改建議另記一張。脆弱原件留在架上，活著的演員開始製作工作劇本。

paragraphs.en: The widow asked that the original script not become another weapon against the performers. She offered to license the abandoned ending to the company, provided the cast approved its use. Evi and the dancers read it together and chose not to copy it exactly. They wanted to add their own words about work, fear, and refusal. Liora felt a strange relief. Although she had fallen into someone else’s novel, its people were no longer waiting for a single author to tell them what to do. A lamp fueled by petrol lit the narrow reading room when dusk arrived. Nilo helped rotate the fragile manuscript stand without touching its pages. Jun said a director must never strangle the cast’s chance to disagree. The widow recovered from surgical treatment before granting access to the archive.
paragraphs.zh: 遺孀要求原稿不要再成為攻擊演員的武器。她願將被棄用結局授權給劇團，但前提是演員同意使用。艾薇和舞者一起閱讀後，決定不逐字照搬。他們想加上自己對工作、恐懼與拒絕的話。莉奧拉感到奇異的輕鬆。即使她跌進別人的小說，裡面的人也不再等待唯一的作者告訴他們該怎麼做。 黃昏時，一盞煤油燈照亮狹窄閱覽室。 尼洛協助轉動脆弱的手稿架，沒有碰觸紙張。 阿筠說導演絕不能扼殺演員表示不同意見的機會。 遺孀在手術治療後康復，才同意開放檔案。

questions.question: What did the first draft ask the dancers to do?
options: Reject the order to sacrifice someone.
questions.explanation: 最初稿的關鍵是舞者集體拒絕犧牲命令。

questions.question: Who decides whether to use the older ending?
options: The cast, under the widow’s license.
questions.explanation: 遺孀授權以演員同意為條件，演員也選擇自行修改。

title: The Cost of an Empty Seat

paragraphs.en: As the artists revised the ending, Anet examined the festival’s public funding. A grant meant to keep cheap seats available had been divided among publicity firms and equipment leases. The theater still collected full price from market workers. Liora insisted that the accounts be audited separately from the mechanical accident, because missing subsidy money could have harmed audiences even if no rope had snapped. Anet convened a group of ticket holders who could compare receipts with the advertised public rates. Anet used simple algebra to reconcile the ticket totals. The term free was not an antonym for accountable in the subsidy rules. The audit aimed to conserve public funds intended for affordable seats. The ticket teller was discreet about visitors’ names until consent was obtained.
paragraphs.zh: 藝術家改寫結局時，安妮特檢查節慶公共補助。一筆原本用來提供平價座位的補助，竟被分流至宣傳公司與設備租賃。市場工人買票時仍付全價。莉奧拉堅持將帳目和機械事故分開稽核，因為即使繩索沒有斷裂，補助款流失仍會傷害觀眾。安妮特召集持票者，以收據與公告票價比對。 安妮特用簡單代數核對票款總額。 在補助規則裡，「免費」並非「負責」的反義詞。 稽核旨在節約並保護原本提供平價座位的公款。 售票員在取得同意前，謹慎保護訪客姓名。

paragraphs.en: At dusk, Jun helped a dancer change the dressing over an old ankle injury before the market performance. Anet set an encyclopedia of city festivals on the portable stage, open at the original cheap-ticket promise. She asked ticket holders to compare that public promise with the amounts on their own receipts. One man had brought only half a torn slip. Anet marked it incomplete rather than dismiss him or invent the missing total. The missing receipts would continue to haunt the grant officials until the auditor could follow the money. For now, the dancer tested the low stage while the queue formed beside the accounts table.
paragraphs.zh: 黃昏市場演出前，阿筠幫舞者更換舊腳傷敷料。安妮特把城市節慶百科放在便攜舞台，翻開原本平價票承諾，請持票人拿自己的收據金額比對。一男子只帶半張撕破單據，安妮特標為不完整，沒趕他，也沒編造缺額。在稽核員追到款項前，缺收據仍會令補助官員不安。此時舞者先測低舞台，隊伍在帳目桌旁排起來。

paragraphs.en: The ticket teller testified that an official had ordered him to record discounted tickets as complimentary gifts, while keeping the money in a separate box. He produced the receipt for that box rather than asking anyone to trust his memory. Corvin claimed the arrangement was a temporary accounting convenience. Liora asked why the box had been delivered to Laurel House instead of the theater treasury. The question drew no immediate answer. It did, however, convince the city auditor to freeze the remaining subsidy. Liora treated the auditor’s apparent indifference as a problem to question, not a verdict. A complete inventory showed the theater had sold more tickets than it reported. A mother sang a lullaby while her child watched the outdoor rehearsal. An outgoing apprentice helped nervous spectators understand the revised scene.
paragraphs.zh: 售票員說曾有官員命令他把折扣票記成免費贈票，收到的錢則放在另一只盒子。他拿出那只盒子的收據，而不是要求大家相信記憶。科爾文稱這只是暫時的會計方便作法。莉奧拉問：盒子為何送到桂冠屋，而非劇院公庫？沒有立刻得到答案，但已足以讓市府稽核員凍結剩餘補助。 莉奧拉把稽核員看似冷漠的態度當成待問問題，而非結論。 完整清冊顯示劇院售票數超過申報數。 一位母親在孩子觀看戶外排練時唱搖籃曲。 一名外向學徒幫緊張觀眾理解改寫場景。

paragraphs.en: A local sportswoman volunteered to direct the queue. Workers would outnumber the palace guests at this performance, and Anet wanted everyone to reach the receipt table without blocking the stage. Several people shouted that the grant had been stolen. She asked them to restrain their anger while the teller checked each payment. The outward appearance of the grant had been generous; the separate money box required an explanation. Liora fetched another blank sheet instead of offering one herself. The teller laid his receipt flat and identified the destination written on it. A crowd's suspicion could now become a question the auditor could put to the recipient.
paragraphs.zh: 當地女運動員自願指揮隊伍。這場演出工人會比王宮賓客多，安妮特希望人人到得了收據桌，又不擋舞台。幾人喊補助被偷，她請眾人抑制怒氣，讓售票員逐筆核款。補助外觀看來慷慨，分開的錢箱卻需要解釋。莉奧拉取來另一張白紙，沒有自己編解釋。售票員攤平收據，指出上面寫的目的地。人群的懷疑如今成了稽核員可向收款人提出的問題。

paragraphs.en: Evi was angry that the investigation kept delaying rehearsals, yet she asked to attend the audit. She wanted to know why young spectators who had saved for months were treated as decorative guests rather than citizens. The cast agreed to perform free scenes in the market while the main stage remained under restriction. Those performances earned no royal praise, but they drew questions the palace could not edit out of its press releases. The story of the theater now belonged to more voices than the patron had planned. She said true sportsmanship meant obeying the same rules as everyone else. The seller hid his paper receipts in a suitcase rather than throwing them away. The auditor called the earliest estimate tentative until all payments matched. The subsidy investigation was already underway when the council requested a new report.
paragraphs.zh: 艾薇因調查不斷拖延排練而生氣，卻仍要求參加稽核。她想知道，為何那些存了數月錢的年輕觀眾被當成裝飾，而不是市民。演員同意主舞台受限期間，在市場免費演出小片段。這些演出沒有王室讚美，卻引出王宮新聞稿無法刪除的問題。劇院故事已由比贊助人預期更多的聲音共同述說。 她說真正的運動家精神，就是遵守與他人相同的規則。 攤販把紙收據藏在手提箱裡，沒有丟棄。 稽核員說最初估算只是暫定，須等所有款項對上。 議會要求新報告時，補助調查早已展開。

questions.question: What was the subsidy supposed to support?
questions.explanation: 補助原本要提供平價公共票券。

questions.question: What happens to the remaining subsidy?
options: It is paid to the playwright.
questions.explanation: 稽核員決定在調查期間凍結剩餘補助。

paragraphs.en: Corvin presented the city council with a proposal: transfer management of every public theater to a private festival company for twenty years. He described the arrangement as the only feasible response to the recent disruptions. The draft contract allowed the new operator to sell workshop equipment and dismiss staff without consultation. Liora asked the council to postpone the vote until the company’s beneficial owners and debts were disclosed. Several councillors accused her of defending her own inherited privilege. A retired admiral warned the council about selling public property without safeguards. Corvin tried to lead the debate astray by attacking Liora’s clothing. A brotherhood of stage carpenters signed a shared objection to the contract. The public clinic asked that employees with diabetes retain access to care.
paragraphs.zh: 科爾文向市議會提出方案：把所有公共劇院的經營權交給一家私人節慶公司，為期二十年。他稱這是面對近期混亂唯一可行的辦法。合約草案允許新經營者出售工坊設備，並在不協商下解雇員工。莉奧拉要求等公司實際所有者與債務公開後再投票。幾名議員反而指控她是在維護自己的世襲特權。 一名退役海軍上將警告議會，不可毫無保障地出售公共財產。 科爾文企圖以批評莉奧拉服裝讓辯論偏離主題。 舞台木匠兄弟會共同簽署反對合約的意見。 公立診所要求糖尿病員工仍能獲得照護。

paragraphs.en: Anet drew two columns on the council board to differentiate artistic management from ownership of the buildings. Corvin's proposal placed both under one company. She asked the clerk to read the proposed fees against the budget; the excess would come from public money while equipment could still be sold privately. Nilo laid out the cost ranges for a feasible repair of the old platform. A councilor predicted the theater's doom if the vote waited. Anet asked which figure supported that prediction. The clerk could find no such calculation in the proposal, and the chair allowed the independent cost sheet to remain beside it.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮特在議會板上畫兩欄，區分藝術管理與建築所有權。科爾文提案把兩者交同一公司。她請書記把擬收費與預算對讀；超額要由公款付，設備卻仍能私人出售。尼洛攤出可行的舊平台修理估價範圍。一名議員預言延後投票會令劇院毀滅，安妮特問哪個數字支持。書記在提案找不到這種計算，議長准許獨立估價繼續與提案並排。

paragraphs.en: Anet brought letters from smaller theaters outside the capital. Their directors feared a private monopoly would make local productions too expensive. Nilo submitted a separate assessment of the main stage’s repair cost, with ranges instead of a single attractive number. The council could compare those costs with the long contract rather than being forced to accept one dramatic claim. Liora also offered to resign from any future governing board, removing her own title from the argument. A feminine stage costume should not determine whether its wearer could speak at the hearing. Public disclosure was imperative before any vote about twenty-year control. The draft would inflict lasting damage on small independent theaters. Two councillors planned to inquire about the private company’s hidden debts.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮特帶來首都外小劇院的信，院長們擔心私人壟斷會讓地方製作成本過高。尼洛另外提交主舞台維修成本評估，使用費用區間，而非漂亮的單一數字。議會因此能把維修費和長期合約比較，不必被迫接受戲劇化的說法。莉奧拉也表示願退出未來管理委員會，把自己的頭銜從爭議中移開。 女性化戲服不應決定穿著者能否在聽證發言。 投票決定二十年經營權前，公開資訊是必要條件。 草案可能對小型獨立劇院造成長久傷害。 兩名議員打算詢問私人公司的隱藏債務。

paragraphs.en: Before the workers entered the chamber, a therapist explained where they could request psychotherapy after the near accident. One dismissed carpenter chose to speak instead about lost wages. Anet let him finish before Nilo showed the radius of the chandelier's unsafe swing on a scaled plan. The woe in the carpenter's account did not become another decoration in Corvin's speech. Liora asked for his written claim to accompany the technical report. The patron invoked the king's reign as if it settled ownership. The chair asked for the relevant grant of authority, then returned to the proposed twenty-year terms when none was produced.
paragraphs.zh: 工人進會議廳前，治療師說明驚險事故後可到哪裡求助心理治療。一名被辭木匠選擇講欠薪。安妮特讓他說完，尼洛再在比例圖上顯示吊燈不安全擺動半徑。木匠敘述的悲苦沒有變成科爾文演說的裝飾，莉奧拉請把他的書面申訴附在技術報告。贊助人引用君王統治，彷彿足以決定所有權。議長要求相關授權，無人提出後，便回到二十年條款。

paragraphs.en: The council delayed its decision for fifteen days and required public hearings in three districts. Corvin seemed furious, but Liora knew delay was only a procedural gain. The theater could still be sold after the hearings. She asked performers to speak about the actual conditions of their work, not about whether she was a good person. It was the hardest request she had made. She might protect the institution and still fail to recover the affection of people she once controlled. A shortcoming in the draft was its silence about dismissed workers. Jun asked the youngest apprentice to tuck the signed copy into a safe folder. The march used the public underpass rather than blocking the emergency entrance. At the wharf, fishers discussed how losing the theater would affect their families.
paragraphs.zh: 議會將表決延後十五日，並要求三個行政區舉行公聽會。科爾文看起來怒不可遏，莉奧拉卻明白延期只是程序上的進展；公聽會後劇院仍可能被出售。她請表演者說明真實工作條件，不必評論她是不是好人。這是她提出過最艱難的要求。她可能保住制度，卻仍無法重新得到曾受她控制之人的喜愛。 草案的一項缺點是完全沒提遭解雇工人。 阿筠請最年輕的學徒把簽署副本塞進安全資料夾。 遊行走公共地下道，沒有堵住緊急入口。 碼頭上，漁民談劇院流失會如何影響家庭。

questions.question: What does Corvin want?
options: Private control of public theaters for twenty years.
questions.explanation: 科爾文要求二十年的公共劇院私人經營權。

questions.question: What does Liora offer to give up?
options: Her place on a future governing board.
questions.explanation: 她願退出日後的管理委員會，避免自身利益左右審查。

paragraphs.en: On the day of the independent load test, Nilo returned with certified pulleys from the mountain mill. The engineers assembled a suspended frame outdoors, away from performers and spectators. Its load matched the disputed chandelier, while measuring instruments recorded strain under repeated movement. At the third cycle, one connector from the earlier shipment cracked. The engineers stopped the test and sealed the remains. They could now prove the part was unsafe under the approved load, but not yet who had knowingly supplied it. The laboratory was an affiliate of the engineering academy, not Corvin’s company. Evi said she would aspire to a safer theater, not an effortless triumph. The old support had been on the brink of failure under repeated stress. A ceramic marker on the platform identified its original manufacturer.
paragraphs.zh: 獨立荷重測試當天，尼洛帶著山區磨坊認證的滑輪回來。工程師在室外遠離演員與觀眾的地方組裝懸吊架，荷重與有爭議的吊燈相同，量測儀器記錄反覆移動的應力。第三輪時，早期貨批的一個接頭裂開。工程師停止測試並封存殘件。他們現在能證明零件在核定荷重下不安全，卻仍無法證明是誰知情供貨。 實驗室隸屬工程學院，而非科爾文公司。 艾薇說她盼望的是更安全的劇院，而非輕易勝利。 舊支撐在反覆受力下已瀕臨失效。 平台上的陶瓷標記指出最初製造商。

paragraphs.en: A chimpanzee figure from the discarded scenery was strapped to the empty test frame to show the space a performer would occupy. Anet kept the crowd behind the barrier. When the connector cracked, some spectators began to chant for arrests. She requested silence so the examiner could state exactly what had failed. The director called the broken glass a distraction from the artistic vision, but Evi pointed to the figure's position beneath the load. At the ticket desk, a clerk confirmed that each coupon would remain valid if the coronation date changed. Nobody needed to rush another test to preserve an audience's purchase.
paragraphs.zh: 廢布景中的黑猩猩模型綁在測試架上，顯示表演者原本站的位置。安妮特讓人群留在障礙後。接頭裂開時，有觀眾齊喊逮捕，她要求安靜，讓鑑定員準確說明哪裡失效。導演說碎玻璃分散藝術主線，艾薇卻指著重物下模型的位置。售票桌的書記確認，若加冕日期改變，每張票券仍有效。不必為保住觀眾購票，就匆忙再測。

paragraphs.en: Liora felt the novel’s final scene returning in her memory: the sound of the falling lamp, Evi trapped beneath it, and a verdict delivered before anyone examined the fragments. This time there was no injured dancer. There was a damaged metal joint, three independent witnesses, and a written test protocol. Corvin called the demonstration reckless, although his office had demanded a live coronation before the test. The city inspector suspended approval of the original chandelier and requested traceable replacement parts. An independent examiner sealed the failed connector after photographing it. Nilo’s instinctive response was to reach toward the frame; he stopped himself. Liora refused to let another young performer perish in a staged accident. The safety committee would not ratify the original permit without new tests.
paragraphs.zh: 莉奧拉想起小說的終幕：吊燈墜落聲、困在下方的艾薇，以及尚未檢查碎片就先宣判的判決。這次沒有受傷的舞者，只有破裂金屬接頭、三名獨立見證人與書面測試程序。科爾文稱這項示範魯莽，儘管他的辦公室曾在測試前要求正式加冕演出。市府檢查員撤銷原吊燈的核准，要求使用可追溯來源的替換零件。 獨立檢查員拍照後封存失效接頭。 尼洛本能地想伸手碰測試架，立刻克制。 莉奧拉拒絕讓另一名年輕演員死於舞台事故。 安全委員會不會在新測試完成前批准原許可。

paragraphs.en: Nilo set the approved test protocol beside the sealed connector. To reproduce the failure, the engineers would need a second controlled trial, not a reckless rehearsal with the cast. Anet asked the examiner to identify the strain reading where the crack had appeared and include it in the public notice. A sergeant guarded the workshop while the sealed evidence was transferred. Outside the fence, a sparrow settled on the rail where spectators had stood. Liora watched the examiner sign the receipt before she signed her own disclosure. The empty space below the frame made the choice before them easier to understand than any promise from the palace.
paragraphs.zh: 尼洛把核准測試程序放在密封接頭旁。要重現失效，工程師須再做受控試驗，不能莽撞讓演員排練。安妮特請鑑定員指出裂開時的應變讀數，寫進公告。封存證據移交時，一名士官看守工坊。柵欄外麻雀落在觀眾先前站的欄杆上。莉奧拉看鑑定員簽收，才簽自己的揭露文件。架下空位比王宮任何承諾，都更能讓人明白眼前選擇。

paragraphs.en: That night the union celebrated cautiously. Some workers wanted Corvin arrested immediately, but Anet reminded them that faulty metal did not establish criminal intent. The company voted to publish the test and demand a separate inquiry into contracts. Liora agreed to share the original approval bearing her own signature. Her mistake had helped the dangerous plan move forward; hiding it now would repeat the choice that had made her a villain in the first place. The theater’s subscription holders received the same factual notice as single-ticket buyers. Thereafter, every load test had to include union observers and signed measurements. A vocational school offered training for apprentices replacing the old cables. Evi practiced yoga to relax her injured ankle between rehearsals.
paragraphs.zh: 當晚工會謹慎慶祝。有些工人要求立刻逮捕科爾文，安妮特提醒，劣質金屬本身不能證明犯罪意圖。劇團投票公開測試，另要求調查合約。莉奧拉同意交出有自己簽名的最初核准書。她的錯誤曾讓危險計畫得以進行；現在若再藏起來，只會重複使她成為惡女的那種選擇。 劇院訂閱會員與單次購票者收到相同事實通知。 此後每次荷重測試都須有工會觀察員和簽署量測。 一所職業學校提供學徒更換舊鋼索的訓練。 艾薇在排練間隙練瑜伽，放鬆受傷腳踝。

questions.question: What does the outdoor load test prove?
options: The earlier connector fails at an approved load.
questions.explanation: 測試證明舊接頭承受核定荷重時裂開。

questions.question: Why does Liora publish her old approval?
options: To claim she never made mistakes.
questions.explanation: 她公開自己的過往批准，避免隱瞞應負的責任。

paragraphs.en: After the load test, the performers, electricians, and costume makers elected a temporary safety council. Liora was allowed to attend but not chair it. The rule offended her pride for a moment before she remembered how easily her own signature had once silenced objections. The council opened with wages: workers whose shifts had been canceled for safety reasons would receive agreed compensation, with a schedule for unpaid arrears. Nilo then demonstrated a relay switch that allowed any department to stop the moving set without waiting for a royal officer. Jun practiced calligraphy to write clear names on the new consent cards. A cardboard corner caught the costume during the emergency-stop rehearsal. Each carton of replacement switches received a separate inventory number. The kitchen agreed to cater meals for the elected worker representatives.
paragraphs.zh: 荷重測試後，演員、電工與戲服工人選出臨時安全委員會。莉奧拉可以出席，卻不能擔任主席。這規定短暫刺痛她的驕傲，隨後她想起自己的簽名曾多麼輕易地壓過異議。委員會先處理工資：因安全理由取消班次的工人可獲議定補償，積欠薪款也排出支付時程。尼洛接著示範一個聯鎖開關，使任何部門都能停止移動布景，不須等待王室官員。 阿筠練習書法，讓新同意卡上的姓名清楚可讀。 緊急停止演練時，紙板角勾住一件戲服。 每箱替換開關都取得不同清冊編號。 廚房同意替選出的工人代表供餐。

paragraphs.en: The first disturbance at the workers' table came from an indignant stagehand holding an unpaid shift card. Liora started to answer, then waited while the elected chair read the wage schedule. The clinic's leaflet about cholesterol and diet lay beneath the card; practical care during long shifts would need funding too. Nilo delayed his demonstration until the pay question was entered in the minutes. He then showed the platform's downward movement with nobody below it. When a door alarm sounded during the drill, the chair stopped him. This interruption, like the wage complaint, would be heard before the meeting moved on.
paragraphs.zh: 工人會議第一陣騷動，來自憤憤不平、拿著未付班次卡的舞台工。莉奧拉本想答話，隨後等民選主席讀欠薪時程。卡下壓著診所膽固醇與飲食傳單；長班的實際照護也須經費。尼洛等薪資問題記入會議紀錄，才示範無人站下方的平台下降。演練中門警報響起，主席叫停。這次中斷像欠薪申訴一樣，得先聽完，會議才能往下走。

paragraphs.en: Jun organized a demonstration with the dressers. A costume piece snagged on a cardboard corner, and the entire group halted the practice. The exercise seemed minor until a young performer explained that she had always been told to keep moving even when something caught her clothing. Anet wrote the account into the new instructions. The council agreed to practice the stop procedure with lights, music, and costumes present. A safety system that worked only when the theater was empty would not protect a real performance. Evi began to marvel at how quickly a shared rule could change behavior. Anet offered to mediate when electricians and dancers disagreed on timing. The successful test was not miraculous; it followed careful preparation. A safety boat kept a paddle near the flooded lower gate.
paragraphs.zh: 阿筠與更衣工一起安排示範。一件戲服勾到紙板邊角，整組人立即停下。這練習原本看似小事，直到一名年輕演員說，過去即使衣服被勾住，她也總被要求繼續移動。安妮特把經驗寫進新指示。委員會同意在燈光、音樂與戲服全都就位時練習停止程序。只在空劇院有效的安全系統，保護不了真正的演出。 艾薇開始驚嘆共同規則可以多快改變行為。 電工和舞者對時間安排有分歧時，安妮特願意居中調解。 測試成功不是奇蹟，而是仔細準備的結果。 安全小艇在淹水的下門旁備有船槳。

paragraphs.en: Jun was persistent about bringing the dressers to the switch demonstration. A porter carried the new controls onto the dry platform, where the technicians checked them before connecting the cooling system. They would purify its water before the next test. Jun handed the stop-signal card to the youngest dresser and asked her to read it without help. She could name the signal but could not see the lamp from behind the costume rack. Nilo moved the indicator rather than tell her to remember its position. Every department would rehearse from its actual working place. Jun marked the corrected sight line on the council's copy.
